# ============================================================
# Online Boutique - Kubernetes Production Deployment
# Based on Google Cloud microservices-demo
#
# Application images: v0.10.7
# Namespace: online-boutique
#
# Includes:
# - Namespace and ServiceAccount
# - 11 application microservices
# - Redis StatefulSet with persistent storage
# - Internal ClusterIP Services
# - External LoadBalancer
# - Health checks and startup probes
# - Resource requests and limits
# - Pod security settings
# - Rolling deployment strategy
# - PodDisruptionBudget
#
# Prerequisites:
# - Kubernetes 1.24+ for native gRPC health probes
# - A default StorageClass for Redis persistence
# - LoadBalancer support for external access
# - Access to the referenced container registry
#
# Source: GoogleCloudPlatform/microservices-demo
# ============================================================

apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: online-boutique
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: online-boutique
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: online-boutique
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted

---
# ============================================================
# SERVICE ACCOUNT
# ============================================================

apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: online-boutique
  namespace: online-boutique
automountServiceAccountToken: false

---
# ============================================================
# REDIS - PERSISTENT CART STORAGE
# ============================================================

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: redis-cart
  namespace: online-boutique
  labels:
    app: redis-cart
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: redis-cart
  ports:
    - name: redis
      port: 6379
      targetPort: 6379
      protocol: TCP

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: redis-cart
  namespace: online-boutique
spec:
  serviceName: redis-cart
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis-cart
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis-cart
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: online-boutique
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 999
        runAsGroup: 999
        fsGroup: 999
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: redis
          image: redis:7.4-alpine
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command:
            - redis-server
          args:
            - "--appendonly"
            - "yes"
            - "--maxmemory"
            - "200mb"
            - "--maxmemory-policy"
            - "allkeys-lru"
            - "--save"
            - "60"
            - "1000"
          ports:
            - name: redis
              containerPort: 6379
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: redis
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: redis
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
          volumeMounts:
            - name: redis-data
              mountPath: /data
            - name: redis-tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
        - name: redis-tmp
          emptyDir: {}
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: redis-data
      spec:
        accessModes:
          - ReadWriteOnce
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 5Gi

---
# ============================================================
# PRODUCT CATALOG SERVICE
# Port: 3550
# ============================================================

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: productcatalogservice
  namespace: online-boutique
  labels:
    app: productcatalogservice
spec:
  replicas: 2
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: productcatalogservice
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: productcatalogservice
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: online-boutique
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: productcatalogservice
          image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/online-boutique-ci/microservices-demo/productcatalogservice:v0.10.7
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: grpc
              containerPort: 3550
          env:
            - name: PORT
              value: "3550"
            - name: DISABLE_PROFILER
              value: "1"
          startupProbe:
            grpc:
              port: 3550
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 30
          readinessProbe:
            grpc:
              port: 3550
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            grpc:
              port: 3550
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 300m
              memory: 128Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: productcatalogservice
  namespace: online-boutique
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: productcatalogservice
  ports:
    - name: grpc
      port: 3550
      targetPort: grpc

# ============================================================
# FRONTEND
# HTTP Port: 8080
# Public-facing application
# ============================================================

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: frontend
  namespace: online-boutique
  labels:
    app: frontend
spec:
  replicas: 3
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: frontend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: frontend
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: online-boutique
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      containers:
        - name: frontend
          image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/online-boutique-ci/microservices-demo/frontend:v0.10.7
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
          env:
            - name: PORT
              value: "8080"
            - name: PRODUCT_CATALOG_SERVICE_ADDR
              value: "productcatalogservice:3550"
            - name: CURRENCY_SERVICE_ADDR
              value: "currencyservice:7000"
            - name: CART_SERVICE_ADDR
              value: "cartservice:7070"
            - name: RECOMMENDATION_SERVICE_ADDR
              value: "recommendationservice:8080"
            - name: SHIPPING_SERVICE_ADDR
              value: "shippingservice:50051"
            - name: CHECKOUT_SERVICE_ADDR
              value: "checkoutservice:5050"
            - name: AD_SERVICE_ADDR
              value: "adservice:9555"
            - name: ENABLE_PROFILER
              value: "0"
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /_healthz
              port: http
              httpHeaders:
                - name: Cookie
                  value: "shop_session-id=x-startup-probe"
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 30
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /_healthz
              port: http
              httpHeaders:
                - name: Cookie
                  value: "shop_session-id=x-readiness-probe"
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /_healthz
              port: http
              httpHeaders:
                - name: Cookie
                  value: "shop_session-id=x-liveness-probe"
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 3
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL

#
# Exposes the demonstration application on HTTP.
# For an Internet-facing production deployment, place
# HTTPS termination, WAF and access controls upstream.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: frontend-external
  namespace: online-boutique
  labels:
    app: frontend
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster
  selector:
    app: frontend
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP

---
# ============================================================
# LOAD GENERATOR
#
# Disabled by default: replicas = 0.
# Scale to 1 to enable synthetic shopping traffic.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: loadgenerator
  namespace: online-boutique
  labels:
    app: loadgenerator
spec:
  replicas: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: loadgenerator
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: loadgenerator
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: online-boutique
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: loadgenerator
          image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/online-boutique-ci/microservices-demo/loadgenerator:v0.10.7
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          env:
            - name: FRONTEND_ADDR
              value: "frontend:80"
            - name: USERS
              value: "10"
            - name: RATE
              value: "1"
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 300m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL

---
# ============================================================
# POD DISRUPTION BUDGETS
# Protect availability during voluntary node disruptions
# ============================================================

apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: frontend-pdb
  namespace: online-boutique
spec:
  minAvailable: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: frontend

---
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget

  name: cartservice-pdb
  namespace: online-boutique
spec:
  minAvailable: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: cartservice

---
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: checkoutservice-pdb
  namespace: online-boutique
spec:
  minAvailable: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: checkoutservice

---
# ============================================================
# HORIZONTAL POD AUTOSCALER - FRONTEND
# Requires Kubernetes Metrics Server
# ============================================================

apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: frontend-hpa
  namespace: online-boutique
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: frontend
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 10
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 70
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
      policies:
        - type: Pods
          value: 1
          periodSeconds: 60
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 30
      policies:
        - type: Pods
          value: 2
          periodSeconds: 60

---
# ============================================================
# NETWORK POLICY
#
# Restricts access to Redis to cartservice.
# Requires a NetworkPolicy-capable CNI plugin.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: redis-cart-ingress
  namespace: online-boutique
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis-cart
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: cartservice
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 6379

---
# ============================================================
# NETWORK POLICY
#
# Allows application pods to communicate with each other
# inside the namespace.
# Also permits frontend HTTP traffic from external clients
# and cluster load balancers.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: application-ingress
  namespace: online-boutique
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchExpressions:
      - key: app
        operator: In
        values:
          - frontend
          - cartservice
          - checkoutservice
          - currencyservice
          - paymentservice
          - shippingservice
          - emailservice
          - productcatalogservice
          - recommendationservice
          - adservice
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector: {}
    - ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 8080
      from: []
      # This rule applies to all selected pods listening
      # on port 8080, not exclusively to frontend.
      # For stricter production isolation, replace with
      # workload-specific NetworkPolicies.
